question: Which of the following semi-solid pharmaceutical forms with which a master formula can be prepared has greater occlusivity ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Hydrophobic ointments" -> "high lipid content" -> "forms a barrier on the skin" -> "greater occlusivity" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Hydrophobic or water-oily creams" -> "contains both water and oil" -> "moderate barrier formation" -> "less occlusivity than hydrophobic ointments" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Hydrophilic or ole-aqueous creams" -> "high water content" -> "less effective barrier" -> "lower occlusivity" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Hydrophilic ointments" -> "water-based formulation" -> "minimal barrier effect" -> "lowest occlusivity" -> 50%
analysis: Hydrophobic ointments are typically more occlusive than creams or hydrophilic formulations because they create a barrier on the skin that prevents moisture loss. Ointments have a higher oil content and lower water content, which enhances their occlusive properties.
